Application to amend zoning for 309 & 311 Hawthorn Street (Holding Removal)
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
This Zoning By-law Amendment application requests to lift the holding symbol on the subject Site. Qing Yuan Investments Ltd is planning the development of a six level apartment building.
This application is technical in nature, as its land use framework and site specific zoning regulations were previously established through City Council approval development applications (files OPA 46 and Z-22-17). Staff recommends that this application is processed through delegated authority to the Director of Planning, thus a formal public hearing and City Council decision may not be required.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
lift the holding symbol relating stationary noise requirements for the mechanical penthouse on the 6th level
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Building height: 6 levels
Number of units: 55
Unit sizes: 10 bachelor, 25 with one-bedroom, 15 with two-bedrooms, 5 with three-bedrooms
Housing type(s): apartment

Bicycle parking: 38
